characters.name: Halvor
characters.description: Once the ash-raker who seemed good for nothing, he proves fearless and relentless, killing three trolls, losing his love by breaking a vow, and trudging on until he wins her back at Soria Moria.
characters.look: A tall, lanky young man of about nineteen with a lazy slouch, a long face, a long straight nose, sleepy, half-closed hazel eyes, a slow lopsided smile and messy auburn hair falling over his forehead, his cheeks smudged with soot. He wears a ragged, soot-streaked grey wool shirt with holes at the elbows, baggy patched brown breeches held up with a length of rope, grey wool stockings and battered brown leather shoes.

characters.name: Halvor in Fine Clothes
characters.description: Halvor dressed by the princesses until he is as fine as any king's son, with the youngest princess's wishing ring on his finger.
characters.look: A tall, lanky young man of about nineteen with a long face, a long straight nose, sleepy hazel eyes, a slow lopsided smile and messy auburn hair falling over his forehead, washed clean and dressed like a king's son: a knee-length royal-blue wool tunic embroidered with gold at the collar and cuffs, a wide lingonberry-red sash, a white linen shirt, dark-grey hose, soft brown leather boots and a short dark-blue cloak fastened with a silver clasp.

characters.name: The Eldest Princess
characters.description: The eldest of the three princesses, found at her spinning wheel in the first castle, where the three-headed troll lives.
characters.look: A tall, stately princess of about twenty-four with warm golden-brown skin, a long oval face, a straight nose, calm dark-brown eyes, neat arched eyebrows and thick black hair coiled into two round buns over her ears. She wears a thin gold circlet, a long plum-purple wool gown with a high collar and long sleeves, and a crisp white linen apron.

characters.name: The Middle Princess
characters.description: The second of the three princesses, held by the six-headed troll, who is so happy to be free that she doesn't know which foot to stand on.
characters.look: A short, lively princess of about twenty-one with warm golden-brown skin, a round face with dimpled cheeks, a small button nose, merry black eyes and glossy black hair cut in a thick, chin-length bob with a straight fringe. She wears a thin gold circlet, a long saffron-yellow wool gown with full sleeves and a wide white sash, and a string of big white pearls.

characters.name: The Youngest Princess
characters.description: The loveliest of the three sisters Halvor frees, clever and commanding; she gifts him the wishing ring, enforces the taboo, and is nearly wed to another before recognizing Halvor by the ring.
characters.look: A graceful, slender young woman of about nineteen with warm golden-brown skin, a heart-shaped face, a small straight nose, large, bright dark-brown eyes with long lashes, a calm, steady gaze and long, straight, glossy black hair falling loose to her waist. She wears a thin gold circlet, a long red wool gown with a square neckline and wide bell sleeves edged with gold braid, and a tiny gold sun pendant on a fine chain.

characters.name: The Three-Headed Troll
characters.description: The troll of the first castle, who pokes all three heads in through the doorway and smells the blood of a Christian man.
characters.look: A big, pear-shaped troll about twice as tall as a man, with knobbly blue-grey skin like wet slate, long dangling arms and huge flat feet. He has exactly three heads side by side on his broad shoulders, each with a big round nose: the left head is sleepy, with droopy eyelids and a floppy faded-red nightcap; the middle head is grumpy, with one bushy black eyebrow; the right head is surprised, with round eyes and a tuft of white hair. He wears a patched brown leather jerkin tied with rope.

characters.name: The Six-Headed Troll
characters.description: The troll of the second castle, so huge and fat that he has to turn sideways to get through the door.
characters.look: A huge, barrel-shaped troll about three times as tall as a man, with pale sandstone-yellow skin covered in brown freckles, warts and crusty patches of lichen, and shoulders so wide that he must turn sideways to get through doors. He has exactly six heads in one long row along his shoulders, each with a long pointed nose, small beady eyes and a stiff tuft of black hair. He wears a huge patchwork coat sewn from old sacks and goes barefoot.

characters.name: The Nine-Headed Troll
characters.description: The greatest and toughest of the castle trolls, massive enough to squeeze through a doorway sideways, whose defeat reunites the three princesses.
characters.look: An enormous troll, the biggest of the three, about four times as tall as a man, with dark charcoal-grey skin, rough and lumpy like wet rock and streaked with moss, a round belly and thick, stumpy legs. He has exactly nine small, round heads on short, thick necks, spread in a wide fan above his shoulders, each with a potato nose, bushy white eyebrows and a wide, frog-like mouth. He wears a ragged sheepskin cloak and a belt of knotted rope.

characters.name: Halvor's Mother
characters.description: Halvor's old mother, who cannot believe the fine gentleman is her son until the glow of the embers falls on his face.
characters.look: A small, sturdy, quick-moving old woman of about sixty with a round chin, a wide mouth made for laughing, a little upturned nose, bright brown eyes and grey-streaked dark-brown hair tucked under a faded indigo headscarf knotted on top of her head. She wears a patched heather-purple wool dress with rolled-up sleeves, a faded green apron and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Halvor's Father
characters.description: Halvor's old father, a quiet man who bows to the grand stranger, not knowing whether his son is alive or dead.
characters.look: A broad, slow-moving, heavy-set old man of about sixty-five with a big round face, ruddy cheeks, a bulbous nose, a bushy salt-and-pepper beard and a bald head under a knitted blue cap. He wears a worn moss-green wool jacket over a collarless linen shirt, patched brown knee breeches, grey knitted stockings and heavy leather boots.

characters.name: The Old Woman of the Forest Hut
characters.description: A strange, very old woman in a lonely forest hut who bargains for Halvor’s horse and provides magic boots, then calls on the moon and the West Wind to guide him toward Soria Moria.
characters.look: A tall, bony, very old woman with a long thin neck, knobbly hands, a wrinkled, cheerful face, small twinkling black eyes and an enormously long, thin, pointed nose with a rosy tip, long enough to poke the embers with. Wisps of dove-grey hair peep out from under a white linen cap. She wears a faded heather-blue wool dress, a black apron and wooden clogs.

characters.name: The West Wind
characters.description: A roaring force of nature that knows the way to Soria Moria, where he is off to dry the wedding clothes, and sets a pace Halvor can barely keep up with even in the old woman’s boots.
characters.look: A wild, friendly wind spirit the size of a big man, with a round, rosy, beardless face, a wide merry grin and bright green eyes. His long streaming hair is made of whirling leaves and spruce needles, with three wooden clothes-pegs clipped in it. From the chest down his body turns into long, curling swirls of misty grey-green air full of spinning leaves, and he has long, thin, gusty arms.

places.name: the Hillside Cottage
places.look: A tiny, poor log cottage with a sagging turf roof and one small window, on a steep hillside above a fjord, with a big farm higher up the slope. Inside: one low, smoke-blackened room with a big open stone hearth in the corner heaped with grey ashes, a rough plank table, a bench along the wall, a water bucket and not a single chair.

places.name: the Grand Hall
places.look: The grandest hall of the third troll castle: vast and high, with walls of pale grey stone, carved and gilded wooden pillars, a floor of wide polished planks, tall arched windows looking out over blue mountains, and one huge arched double door of dark oak bound with iron. In one corner stands a tall stove of grey soapstone, glowing warm, with a carved chair beside it.
